'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Brian Hunter LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hunter]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Hunter
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
